Discovery Name: "The Coins of the Lighthouse of Alexandria"
Discovery Details: "Coins manufactured in ancient Aleandria with the inscriptions of various elaborated designs such as Isis, the guardian goddess of journeys across the seas, along with the Lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the World's Seven Wonders.

Quest Name: Lighthouse and the Guardian Goddess
Skill Required: R6 Search, R8 Archaeology, Arabic

Quest Details: The guardian goddess which voyagers believe in and anecdotes regarding the Lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the Seven Wonders of the world... Perhaps, you may be able to investigate into them in detail at the Archives in Alexandria.

Quest obtained with 14-star clue "A Record of the Lighthouse of Alexandria and Voyagers" from new Treasure Hunt Legend Regarding an Old Map
